title: Mineable Frosted Ice
description: Allows to collect ice generated by Frost Walker users.
body:
With this simple datapack you may easily collect ice blocks generated by any mob or player wearing Frost Walker boots, whilst not changing core features of the Frosted Ice blocks. The only requirement is to have a pickaxe enchanted with silk touch (just as if you were mining regular Ice blocks).
Best to be used with mods improving Frost Walker enchantment (e.g. [Better Frost Walker](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-frost-walker)), otherwise the usability is limited mostly to the player-centred contraptions (who will need to constatly move to re-generate Frosted Ice) ### Compatibility - Any mod/datapack that does not change loot table of the Frosted Ice (you may need to put this datapack higher in load order to keep its functionality if some other datapack changes it) - supported from 1.21 to 1.21.11
